reuse.why: Calls the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, isDailyWeekendSkip and getDateWithSkippedWeekend from shared/schedules.ts; the per-occurrence pipeline built from them is not itself shared.

duplication.why: The filter(daily weekend skip) + map(skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend : date) + dayFromDate chain is copied from getUpcomingDates (and mirrors getNextDate/schedule-template), along with the RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb skeleton.

placement.why: Handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like its siblings; the occurrence-to-final-day pipeline would better live in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration, imports and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Typed, short and commented; a future weekend-rule change must also be mirrored in this copy of the pipeline.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied pipeline keeps the same shape as getUpcomingDates; it is not renamed or reshaped.
